parole.significato: The hybrid of a domestic duck and wild ducks; a manky mallard.
parole.testo: From taxonomic name Anas (itself from Latin anas (“duck”), found in the taxonomic names of several duck species, and the brand name Unox, known primarily for their sausages. The brand name Unox here is perhaps a reference to the term soepeend (literally “soup duck”), a semi-jocular term for domestic
